description.en: Community plugins for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区插件索引。

description.en: Recall and consolidate project memory with handoff ledgers, planning notes and context tracking.
description.zh: 召回并整理项目记忆，保存交接账本、计划笔记与上下文状态。

description.en: Accessibility-first macOS Computer Use capability for DeepSeek Harness with stale-observation protection, app leases, confirmations, screenshots, and Web diagnostics
description.zh: 通过辅助功能、截图与应用控制工具操作 macOS 桌面。

description.en: Turn-level conversation and workspace rewind for DeepSeek Harness, powered by a persistent Change Ledger
description.zh: 基于持久变更账本回退会话轮次和工作区文件。

description.en: Use image questions, OCR, grounding, UI reconstruction and pixel comparisons in DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中进行图片问答、OCR、定位、界面还原与像素比较。

description.en: Connect AnySearch web search, page fetching and advanced search tools to DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 AnySearch 网页搜索、正文抓取与高级检索工具。

description.en: Feishu/Lark bridge for local coding agents — one group, one conversation, one pinned runtime. Bridges dsh, CLI agents (traex/codex), an IDE window, or a custom agent behind one gateway.
description.zh: 通过飞书群组连接本机 DSH、编程命令行或 IDE 助手。

description.en: Local WebSocket bridge between dsh and the DSH Browser Control browser extension, with model-facing browser_* tools and a Settings-managed on/off switch
description.zh: 连接浏览器扩展，向 Agent 提供网页操作工具与开关。

description.en: DSH Web selection-annotation plugin: select assistant text, annotate (optional), and press Enter to send the annotation block with your message — the model replies to each annotation by number, with hoverable chips in the reply.
description.zh: 选择助手回复中的文字并添加批注，让模型按编号逐条回应。

description.en: Render interactive charts, forms, diagrams and other UI inside assistant replies.
description.zh: 在助手回复中呈现交互图表、表单、流程图等界面。

description.en: Manage CloudBase databases, storage, authentication and application deployment from DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理 CloudBase 数据库、存储、身份认证与应用部署。

description.en: Search anime sources, inspect details and access playback links inside a conversation.
description.zh: 在会话中搜索动画来源、查看详情并使用播放入口。

description.en: A persistent agent team for long-running collaboration in DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为长期任务保存 Agent 团队与协作状态。

description.en: Unified capability management for the DeepSeek Harness: catalog (ctx.capability) + meta_search/meta_invoke + Resident/On-demand/Disabled projection policy + 能力菜单 settings tab, in one installable bundle (server + browser).
description.zh: 统一管理能力目录，按需检索和调用工具，并设置投影策略。

description.en: Manage agents, sessions and tools through an interactive terminal interface.
description.zh: 通过交互终端界面管理 Agent、会话和工具。

description.en: Combine a calendar, hierarchical tasks, AI planning, execution reviews and desktop reminders.
description.zh: 组合日历、分层任务、AI 拆解、执行复盘与桌面提醒。

description.en: Generate and edit images through configurable provider channels in the web interface.
description.zh: 在网页界面配置供应商通道，生成或编辑图片。

description.en: Official DingTalk connector for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 通过钉钉连接 DSH 会话与消息。

description.en: Session-state notification plugin for the dsh web GUI: session completed/failed, question-asked, and permission-requested alerts with configurable built-in or custom sounds and browser notifications, plus a Notifications settings section
description.zh: 为会话完成、失败、提问和权限请求配置声音与浏览器通知。

description.en: Inspect local tools, model configuration, hardware and listening ports, and export diagnostics.
description.zh: 检查系统、命令行工具、模型配置、硬件与监听端口，并导出诊断。

description.en: Inspect model catalogs, provider status, balances and usage, and connect locally installed coding agents.
description.zh: 查看模型目录、供应商状态、余额配额与用量，并接入本机编程助手。

description.en: Track token and cache usage, account balances and billing, with exportable records.
description.zh: 追踪 Token 与缓存用量、账户余额和费用，并导出记录。

description.en: Store conversation knowledge in Markdown cognitive graphs with recall and reflection tools.
description.zh: 将会话知识保存到 Markdown 认知图，提供召回与反思工具。

description.en: Fylar Office Editor integration for the DeepSeek Harness Web profile, powered by Fylar Office SDK
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页中接入 Fylar Office SDK 文档编辑器。

description.en: Agent-Native document handling for DSH — addressable blocks let an agent read and edit one section instead of the whole file. Ships the geml MCP server and the authoring and code-graph skills.
description.zh: 按可寻址内容块读取和编辑文档，并提供文档与代码图技能。

description.en: Transcribe and search PDFs, then read papers with a built-in viewer and conversation tools.
description.zh: 转录和检索 PDF，通过内置阅读器配合会话阅读论文。

description.en: Provide switchable Russian localization for DSH and ecosystem plugins.
description.zh: 为 DSH 核心与生态插件提供可切换的俄语界面。

description.en: dsh-tianshu-tui: an interactive terminal UI plugin for the official DeepSeek Harness — streaming markdown/tool cards, 16+ themes, slash commands, session tabs, LSP diagnostics, cost tracking, self-update (`dsh plugin --profile tui add @huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui`)
description.zh: 在终端中浏览流式回复、工具卡片、会话、诊断与费用。

description.en: Configure reasoning effort for third-party models and default subagent settings.
description.zh: 为第三方模型配置思考强度，并设置子 Agent 的默认档位。

description.en: Install reusable plugin templates, development tools and a bundled starter collection.
description.zh: 安装可复用的插件模板、开发工具与入门组合包。

description.en: Command Code Go provider adapter for dsh: scan the Go-plan model catalog dynamically and serve /alpha/generate through the harness LLM seam
description.zh: 动态读取 Go 套餐模型目录，并通过 DSH 模型接口调用。

description.en: OpenCode Zen free models provider for dsh
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 OpenCode Zen 免费模型通道。

description.en: Browse, search and preview workspace files, then insert references by clicking or dragging.
description.zh: 在侧栏浏览、搜索和预览文件，点击或拖拽插入引用。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness (memory palace · AGI Architecture Exploration on dsh-market): dual-scope SQLite memory graph, hybrid retrieval, provenance audit, and a knowledge flywheel.
description.zh: 用 SQLite 记忆图、混合检索和来源记录保存跨会话知识。

description.en: Usage billing dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar cost metrics plus a full dashboard modal, priced from a current multi-provider catalog with real usage aggregated from session logs.
description.zh: 从会话日志汇总实际用量，显示多供应商价格与侧栏费用指标。

description.en: Browse branch history and run workspace Git operations from the web interface.
description.zh: 在网页界面查看分支历史，并操作工作区 Git 仓库。

description.en: Browse, enable, create and remove skills grouped by their source.
description.zh: 按来源浏览、开关、创建和删除技能。

description.en: In-GUI skin center for the dsh web GUI — the single skin package: skins are pure asset directories (built-in plus $DSH_HOME/skins) loaded and rendered only by the skin center; live try-on and one-click apply switch atomically in the page (no reload, no cordis.patch.yml rewrite, no restart)
description.zh: 浏览本地主题素材，实时试用并应用网页皮肤。

description.en: Manage agent tasks, scheduled runs and execution state from the web interface.
description.zh: 在网页界面管理 Agent 任务、定时执行和运行状态。

description.en: Pair phones and computers with the web interface over LAN or an optional Cloudflare tunnel.
description.zh: 通过局域网或 Cloudflare 隧道扫码配对手机与电脑，访问同一网页界面。

description.en: Connect SSH hosts with remote commands, terminals, SFTP and port forwarding.
description.zh: 连接 SSH 主机，使用远程命令、终端、SFTP 与端口转发。

description.en: Install a collection of task, Git, remote-access and appearance extensions for the web interface.
description.zh: 组合安装任务、Git、远程访问和界面外观扩展。

description.en: Add image understanding for text-only models through a separate vision provider.
description.zh: 通过独立视觉供应商为纯文本模型提供图片理解。

description.en: Search the web and X, fetch page content, and switch between search engines when a request fails.
description.zh: 搜索网页和 X 内容、抓取正文，并在请求失败时切换搜索引擎。

description.en: A real PowerPoint, not HTML. Editable .pptx decks for AI agents, rendered on your own machine.
description.zh: 在本机生成和渲染可编辑的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。

description.en: Standalone OpenTelemetry GenAI observability plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 OpenTelemetry 生成式 AI 可观测数据。

description.en: Register Command Code models and a provider configuration card in DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中注册 Command Code 模型与供应商配置卡片。

description.en: Configure speech engines such as Edge TTS and read messages manually or automatically.
description.zh: 配置 Edge TTS 等语音引擎，手动或自动朗读消息。

description.en: Archive, restore, favorite and remove sessions, and diagnose damaged session logs.
description.zh: 归档、恢复、收藏和删除会话，并诊断损坏的会话日志。

description.en: Manage local and project skills with repository installs, update previews, backups, and restoration.
description.zh: 管理本机与项目技能，支持仓库安装、更新预览及备份恢复。

description.en: Custom Claude provider support for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2
description.zh: 为 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 接入自定义 Claude 供应商。

description.en: Harness-neutral reliability infrastructure for AI coding agents: reversible destructive actions, pre-emission redaction, recovery evidence, and a shared Decision Protocol with optional native adapters.
description.zh: 提供可逆操作、输出脱敏、恢复证据与共享决策协议。

description.en: Detect repeated reasoning and output patterns and interrupt degenerate model calls.
description.zh: 检测重复思考与输出模式，中断陷入循环的模型调用。

description.en: Render interactive HTML fragments as sandboxed cards inside conversation replies.
description.zh: 在会话回复中将交互 HTML 片段渲染为沙箱卡片。

description.en: Coordinate agent teams with task dependencies, direct messaging and a web monitor.
description.zh: 通过任务依赖、直接消息与网页监视器协调 Agent 团队。

description.en: Apply Catppuccin color schemes and an optional translucent web skin.
description.zh: 应用 Catppuccin 配色与可选的半透明网页皮肤。

description.en: Manage plugin sources and framework upgrades with rollback and compatibility gates.
description.zh: 管理插件来源与框架升级，使用回滚和兼容性检查。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: control the Unity Editor through the unity CLI — project management, live-editor pipeline commands, and C# eval as agent tools.
description.zh: 通过 Unity 命令行管理项目、执行编辑器流程和 C# 代码。

description.en: Free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): native dsh-llm adapter plugin, no API key.
description.zh: 通过原生适配器为 DSH 接入 OpenCode Zen 模型。

description.en: Terminal-native ACP client UI; Cordis client tree, any ACP agent
description.zh: 在终端中使用 ACP Agent 与 Cordis 客户端树。

description.en: Connect OpenViking memory and context services to DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 OpenViking 记忆与上下文服务。

description.en: Manage project tasks in a local SQLite board with agent assignments, execution tracking and human review.
description.zh: 用本地 SQLite 看板管理项目任务，支持 Agent 领取、执行跟踪和人工验收。

description.en: Apply a navy whale-maid theme and character sidebar to the web interface.
description.zh: 为网页界面添加深蓝鲸鱼女仆主题与角色侧栏。

description.en: QQ Bot IM channel plugin for deepseek-harness (dsh)
description.zh: 通过 QQ Bot 连接 DSH 消息与会话。

description.en: Terminal front door for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): an out-of-tree TUI mode bundle over dsh-base
description.zh: 为 DSH 配置提供独立的终端界面组合包。

description.en: Turn plans and codebases into interactive architecture diagrams through a bundled skill.
description.zh: 用内置技能把方案与代码库整理为可交互的架构图。

description.en: Adjust model reasoning effort with a configurable slider in the web interface.
description.zh: 通过网页界面的可配置滑块调整模型推理强度。

description.en: Manage local skills from multiple coding agents, import them into DSH and browse a skill market.
description.zh: 管理多种编程助手的本地技能，并导入 DSH 与浏览技能市场。

description.en: Remote access & authentication for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: login gate, MFA (TOTP), signed session cookies, role-based access, in-browser directory picker, account management settings. Fully localized (zh/en).
description.zh: 为网页界面提供登录、多因素认证、角色权限与远程目录选择。

description.en: Back up, restore and migrate DSH data with scheduled snapshots and session-log diagnostics.
description.zh: 通过定时快照备份、恢复和迁移 DSH 数据，并诊断会话日志。

description.en: The dsh-pi-tui bundle: a TUI surface for DeepSeek Harness profiles (dsh --profile pi-tui)
description.zh: 为 DSH 配置安装 Pi 风格的终端界面。

description.en: Analyze and rewrite prompts beside the composer using the current session model.
description.zh: 使用当前会话模型，在输入栏旁分析并改写提示词。

description.en: Token usage, provider accounts, session cost estimates, budgets, and exports for the dsh web GUI
description.zh: 查看 Token 用量、供应商账户、会话费用、预算与导出记录。

description.en: Manage database connections and metadata catalogs, then query them through SQL and catalog tools.
description.zh: 管理数据库连接与元数据目录，通过 SQL 和目录工具进行查询。

description.en: MuseAI tavern for the dsh web GUI: a MuseAI conversation-view tab (right of Trajectory) with background / chat / adventure / bond / settings pages ported from MuseAI, running entirely on models configured in DeepSeek Harness (no separate API config)
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型配置上运行带聊天、冒险与角色页面的 MuseAI 界面。

description.en: Persistent project memory for dsh agents: index docs (PDF/Markdown/text) and code symbols into a searchable per-workspace store, recall them with cited sources, and keep experience entries (problems -> solutions) searchable on demand.
description.zh: 索引工作区文档和代码符号，带来源召回项目经验。

description.en: Use structured learning skills and a lesson engine inside DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用结构化学习技能与课程引擎。

description.en: QQ Bot IM channel plugin for deepseek-harness (dsh)
description.zh: 通过 QQ Bot 为 DSH 提供即时消息通道。

description.en: DSH web plugin: VSCode Remote-SSH-like remote development (SSH to supercomputers/servers, remote workspace, file explorer, integrated terminal), integrated with dsh-better-sidebar and DSH settings.
description.zh: 连接服务器或超算，在远程工作区使用文件浏览器与终端。

description.en: Combine output limits, result caching, file diffs, tool pruning and lazy MCP loading.
description.zh: 组合使用输出限制、结果缓存、文件差异、工具裁剪与 MCP 延迟加载。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Android — build, run, and interact with a live emulator or USB device stream inside a conversation, driven entirely through adb. Tested with DSH 0.1.5-rc.1.
description.zh: 通过 adb 在会话中构建、运行并操作模拟器或 USB 设备。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex, as native subagents with live progress
description.zh: 从 Claude Code 或 Codex 调用 DSH 子 Agent，并查看实时进度。

description.en: A read-only mirror for installed DeepSeek Harness plugins: capability inventory with evidence, cross-plugin conflicts, a diff of what changed since the last scan, and an upgrade preflight that tells you which profiles still boot on a newer DSH
description.zh: 只读查看已安装插件的能力、冲突、变更与升级前检查。

description.en: Build, run and interact with an iOS Simulator stream inside a conversation.
description.zh: 在会话中构建、运行并操作 iOS 模拟器画面。

description.en: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
description.zh: 提供可检查的持久记忆、召回工具与设置界面。

description.en: Preview, inspect, and edit real .op OpenPencil design documents inside DSH conversations — headless rendering, a read-only canvas, and a managed editor.
description.zh: 在会话中预览、检查与编辑 OpenPencil 设计文档。

description.en: Inspect related subagent sessions and delete selected conversation families from the sidebar.
description.zh: 查看关联子 Agent 会话，并在侧栏选择删除会话组。

description.en: Organize evidence-backed research as a browsable domain ontology.
description.zh: 将有证据支持的研究整理为可浏览的领域本体。

description.en: Deep reading & summarization for DSH: books/papers/videos/web → structured Markdown notes (Obsidian / Logseq / static sites). Plugin parsers, MapReduce deep-read, JSON Schema-constrained sub-tasks.
description.zh: 将书籍、论文、视频和网页整理为结构化 Markdown 笔记。

description.en: Fail-closed password authentication proxy bundle for the DeepSeek Harness Web profile
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页配置提供密码认证代理。

description.en: Adjust interface layout and conversation prompt behavior through configurable enhancements.
description.zh: 通过可配置扩展调整界面布局与会话提示词行为。

description.en: Compose prompts, tools, skills, subagents and fallback models in a visual configuration panel.
description.zh: 可视化组合提示词、工具、技能、子 Agent 与备用模型。

description.en: Fetch rendered pages, search multiple sources and automate indexed browser sessions.
description.zh: 抓取渲染后的网页、检索多个来源，并自动操作浏览器会话。

description.en: Use a floating workspace for image, video, short-drama and story creation tools.
description.zh: 在浮动工作区中使用图片、视频、短剧和故事创作工具。

description.en: Google Antigravity (agy) OAuth auth + model access plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multi-account pool, 429 rotation, device fingerprinting, CLI and web login.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 连接 Google Antigravity，并管理多账户模型访问。

description.en: Customize theme colors and image or video wallpapers with separate opacity and blur controls for interface areas.
description.zh: 自定义主题色与图片或视频壁纸，分别调整各区域的透明度和模糊度。

description.en: Claude Code style auto-memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: typed memory files + MEMORY.md index auto-injected into the system prompt
description.zh: 自动注入 MEMORY.md 索引，管理分类的跨会话记忆文件。

description.en: Second-model AI auto-review for DeepSeek Harness approval requests: a read-only reviewer subagent decides allow/deny on the approval answerer chain, with fail-closed fallback and full session-log audit.
description.zh: 使用独立只读模型复核权限请求，并记录审批过程。

description.en: Assign wallpapers and appearance settings to model rules and rotate matching images.
description.zh: 按模型规则配置壁纸和外观，并轮播匹配的图片。

description.en: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers.
description.zh: 调整过程细节、实时思考与最终回答的显示方式。

description.en: Hash-anchored read/edit/undo_last_edit tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Every line gets a unique 3-char hash (A-Za-z0-9) that stays stable across edits; stale or ambiguous anchors are rejected, never fuzzy-matched. Undo persists across restarts.
description.zh: 通过行哈希执行读取、编辑和撤销，拒绝过期或歧义锚点。

description.en: Better input experience for DeepSeek Harness: file-to-Markdown, local file input, prompt optimization, and voice input
description.zh: 提供文件转 Markdown、本地文件引用、提示词优化与语音输入。

description.en: Keep files, an editor, changes, tasks and side chat together in a per-conversation sidebar.
description.zh: 在每个会话的侧栏中查看文件、编辑器、变更、任务与旁聊。

description.en: Organize workspace navigation by disk paths with optional name-based grouping.
description.zh: 按磁盘目录组织工作区导航，并可启用名称分组。

description.en: Read video subtitles, select relevant material and produce daily digests and notifications.
description.zh: 读取视频字幕并筛选内容，生成日报与消息提醒。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Blender production, reconstruction, validation, and export plugin
description.zh: 在 DSH 中调用 Blender 制作、重建、验证与导出流程。

description.en: Apply light-adaptive color schemes and frosted-glass interface styling.
description.zh: 应用可自适应深浅模式的配色与磨砂玻璃界面。

description.en: Show the current model, account balance or subscription quota, and session or historical spending beneath the composer.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示模型、余额或订阅额度，以及会话与历史费用。

description.en: Use a visible browser that the agent can automate and the user can take over.
description.zh: 使用可由 Agent 自动操作、也可由用户接管的可见浏览器。

description.en: View 2D and 3D CAD files and use parametric modeling and export tools from a conversation.
description.zh: 在会话中查看二维与三维 CAD 文件，并调用参数化建模与导出工具。

description.en: Connect CalDAV calendars to view, create, reschedule, and import events from DSH.
description.zh: 连接 CalDAV 日历，在会话中查看、创建和调整日程，并导入日历文件。

description.en: Query community plugin assessment records, evidence snapshots, and scoring rules through read-only DSH or MCP tools.
description.zh: 通过只读工具查询社区插件评估记录、证据快照与评分规范。

description.en: Import AI coding agent conversations as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions.
description.zh: 将 AI 编程助手聊天记录导入为可继续对话的 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

description.en: Snapshot sessions, workspaces and configuration, compare changes and restore a checkpoint.
description.zh: 保存会话、工作区和配置快照，查看差异并一键回退。

description.en: Four-source migration wizard: copy Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions — copy-only, approval-gated, idempotent
description.zh: 预览并复制多种编程助手的会话、记忆、技能与指令到 DSH。

description.en: Inspect desktop screens and applications, then use approval-gated mouse and keyboard tools.
description.zh: 查看桌面画面与应用，使用需要审批的鼠标和键盘操作工具。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin: automatically sends a localized continue prompt when a request is interrupted by network errors or other non-human causes
description.zh: 在网络错误等非人工中断后自动发送继续提示。

description.en: ChatGPT OAuth, Codex models, search, read_image URL support, and configurable GPT Image generation for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 接入 Codex，并提供搜索、看图与可配置生图工具。

description.en: Connect eligible ChatGPT and Codex subscriptions through OAuth and view account quotas in DSH.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 接入 ChatGPT 与 Codex 订阅模型，并查看账户额度。

description.en: Run local or remote ComfyUI workflows with asset panels and per-workflow skills.
description.zh: 运行本机或远程 ComfyUI 工作流，管理素材面板与工作流技能。

description.en: Use screenshots and vision models with virtual-mouse and desktop-operation tools.
description.zh: 结合截图与视觉模型，提供虚拟鼠标和桌面操作工具。

description.en: Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: an MCP stdio server + PowerShell UIA backend, bridged into DSH via @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client. Read/act on real Windows desktop apps (UI Automation tree, screenshots, typed input, OCR, window management).
description.zh: 通过 UI Automation、截图、OCR 与 PowerShell 操作 Windows 应用。

description.en: Connect locally signed-in Trae models with separate domestic and international providers.
description.zh: 接入本机已登录的 Trae 模型，分别管理国内与国际供应商。

description.en: Connect locally signed-in WorkBuddy models and view account credits.
description.zh: 接入本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 模型，并查看账户积分。

description.en: Inspect context composition, changes and compression from a dashboard and command.
description.zh: 通过面板和命令查看上下文组成、变化与压缩情况。

description.en: Browse a collapsible turn-by-turn outline, jump to messages and track the current scroll position.
description.zh: 按轮次查看可折叠大纲，点击跳转并跟踪当前滚动位置。

description.en: Track session and daily model costs alongside account balances, budgets, and subscription usage.
description.zh: 统计会话与每日模型费用，显示账户余额、预算和订阅套餐用量。

description.en: Profile, clean and verify structured datasets through deterministic tools.
description.zh: 通过确定性工具分析、清理和验证结构化数据。

description.en: Know when your DeepSeek Harness tasks need you. Local alerts, quiet notifications, and a task inbox.
description.zh: 通过本机提醒、通知与任务收件箱查看需要关注的会话。

description.en: Apply detection rules to messages, tool arguments and results, with auditable allow, ask or block decisions.
description.zh: 对消息、工具参数与结果应用检测规则，记录允许、询问或阻止的决策。

description.en: Search and recall local session histories from other coding agents without an LLM indexer.
description.zh: 检索和召回其他编程助手的本地会话历史，无需模型建立索引。

description.en: Session manager for DeepSeek Harness: list, archive, unarchive and permanently delete sessions from a settings page.
description.zh: 在设置页列出、归档、恢复和永久删除会话。

description.en: Download, update and launch a desktop shell with shortcuts and a launch tool.
description.zh: 下载、更新并启动桌面外壳，创建快捷方式与启动工具。

description.en: Store project knowledge in editable Markdown files shared across sessions in the same project.
description.zh: 将项目知识保存为可编辑的 Markdown 文件，供同一项目的多个会话共享。

description.en: Delivery quality gate for DeepSeek Harness: grill the requirements, test the implementation, prove the delivery, and gate the handoff with a deliverable/rework decision.
description.zh: 通过需求澄清、实现检查与交付证据决定交付或返工。

description.en: Edit a sidebar canvas and read or update .drawio files through diagram tools.
description.zh: 在侧栏编辑画布，并通过语义绘图工具读写 .drawio 文件。

description.en: Switch between shareable themes with wallpapers, accent colors and translucent surfaces.
description.zh: 切换可分享的主题，调整壁纸、强调色与半透明界面。

description.en: Recall and re-edit messages in the web conversation.
description.zh: 撤回并重新编辑网页会话中的消息。

description.en: Inspect per-turn skill usage and manage installed skills and their upstream updates.
description.zh: 查看每轮技能调用，并管理已安装技能及其上游更新。

description.en: Drive browser automation tools and watch or interact with the live browser view.
description.zh: 调用浏览器自动化工具，并查看或操作实时浏览器画面。

description.en: Connect multiple mail accounts to send, receive, and search messages with attachments, drafts, and sending approvals.
description.zh: 连接多个邮箱，在会话中收发和搜索邮件，并管理附件、本地草稿与发信审批。

description.en: Use C/C++ firmware skills covering RTOS, interrupts, storage, debugging and architecture.
description.zh: 使用涵盖实时系统、中断、存储、调试和架构的 C/C++ 固件开发技能。

description.en: Review DeepSeek Harness file changes in native sidebar tabs
description.zh: 在原生侧栏标签页中审阅工作区文件变更。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness dual-face plugin: Codex-style file references (@path), fully bundled document→Markdown (MarkItDown engine, 20+ formats), mature image handling (read_image for multimodal routes, automatic vision descriptions for text-only models), read_document tool.
description.zh: 上传和引用文件，将文档转为 Markdown，并提供图片与文档读取工具。

description.en: Visualize session execution, tool calls and concurrent agent branches.
description.zh: 可视化会话执行过程、工具调用与并发 Agent 分支。

description.en: Adjust conversation, interface, and code typography and save, import, or export presets.
description.zh: 分别调整对话、界面和代码的字体样式，并保存、导入和导出排版预设。

description.en: Search and fetch pages through multiple engines with configurable routing, filters and fallbacks.
description.zh: 使用多个引擎搜索和抓取网页，自定义路由、筛选与失败切换。

description.en: Collect public fund data and inspect holdings, manager history and performance metrics.
description.zh: 整理公开基金数据，查看持仓、基金经理履历与业绩指标。

description.en: Generate game sprites, animation frames, maps, images and music through dedicated tools.
description.zh: 通过专用工具生成游戏精灵、动画帧、地图、图片与音乐。

description.en: GenUI for DeepSeek Harness: interactive charts, forms, calculators, dashboards, and mini apps rendered inline in assistant replies, with actions that flow back to the model.
description.zh: 在回复中渲染图表、表单、计算器与小应用，并将操作反馈给模型。

description.en: Run a dedicated Git Bash executor and terminal integration on Windows.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上使用独立 Git Bash 命令执行器与终端集成。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for graph-based goal management and kanban visualization.
description.zh: 通过关系图与看板管理 Agent 目标。

description.en: A library for patching, replacing and decorating DeepSeek Harness plugins during runtime
description.zh: 在运行时修补、替换或装饰 DSH 插件。

description.en: DSH-native HarmonyOS dev assistant: hdc device debugging, an input-row development panel, official-first versioned API docs, DevEco compile assistance, and standalone Command Line Tools support.
description.zh: 接入 hdc 设备调试、版本化 API 文档和 DevEco 编译辅助。

description.en: Inspect assistant presence across workspaces and move assistants between workspaces.
description.zh: 查看各工作区助手的在线状态，并调整工作区归属。

description.en: Connect image-generation providers and local ComfyUI to the conversation.
description.zh: 在会话中接入多家图片生成供应商与本地 ComfyUI。

description.en: Zoom, browse, download, and annotate image regions in the DSH conversation viewer.
description.zh: 为会话图片提供缩放、多图浏览、原图下载和区域标注。

description.en: Collect public-source industry and company evidence, map industry chains and draft research reports.
description.zh: 整理公开行业与公司证据，绘制产业链并编写研究报告。

description.en: Millisecond System-1 judgement for every tool call in DeepSeek Harness: Jev-powered risk classification and evidence-gated auto-approval, fail-closed by construction.
description.zh: 使用 Jev 分类工具调用风险，并基于证据处理自动审批。

description.en: Apply the Joi Flowers or Joi Library fan theme to the web interface.
description.zh: 为网页界面应用 Joi Flowers 或 Joi Library 同人主题。

description.en: Connect Kimi Code subscription models using API keys or device sign-in, with web search and quota displays.
description.zh: 接入 Kimi Code 订阅模型，支持设备登录、网页搜索和额度查询。

description.en: Kimi no Na wa (Your Name) theme for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — dynamic Cordis plugin source (host + client halves) plus an installable dsh bundle, with wallpaper/logo assets
description.zh: 为网页界面添加《你的名字》主题与壁纸素材。

description.en: Context retrieval for DeepSeek Harness: ranks docs, code and media by relevance into a sidebar Context Pack. Lexical and fully local by default. Hybrid is off until you configure a provider; it sends your query and file titles/summaries, not bodies.
description.zh: 检索并排序文档、代码与媒体，在侧栏组织上下文资料。

description.en: Cherry Studio-style knowledge base system for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): bases, documents, chunking, embeddings (OpenAI-compatible / Ollama / local / lexical fallback), retrieval, model-facing tools, and a browser management panel
description.zh: 管理文档、分块与向量检索，并通过工具和面板查询知识库。

description.en: High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness — QR one-click auth, multi-mode agents, card-based commands, zero-loss outbox, media in/out, session logs, reusable DSH Web GUI
description.zh: 通过扫码登录、卡片命令与媒体消息连接飞书和 DSH。

description.en: Index local documents for hybrid search, context retrieval and citation checks.
description.zh: 为本地文档建立索引，进行混合检索、上下文召回与引用检查。

description.en: Live2D pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a characterful agent companion — follows session state, switchable personas, bring-your-own models
description.zh: 添加随会话状态变化的 Live2D 角色，支持人设与自有模型。

description.en: Connect ChatGPT subscription models using locally stored Codex CLI sign-in credentials.
description.zh: 复用本机 Codex CLI 登录凭据，为 DSH 接入 ChatGPT 订阅模型。

description.en: Configurable DSH-native LLM verifier with a Web settings page
description.zh: 通过网页设置配置 DSH 原生模型验证器。

description.en: Local-model (Ollama) integration for DeepSeek Harness: discover, pull, remove, and inspect local models, route requests to them by task type or keyword with automatic fallback to the cloud, and get a one-shot status overview via /ollama.
description.zh: 发现和管理本地模型，按任务路由调用，并可回退到云端模型。

description.en: LSP action surface for DeepSeek Harness: diagnostics, formatting, completion, code actions, symbols, signature help, inlay hints, and rename tools over language servers, plus the editor action protocol (lsp.actions.*) that makes the plugin the IDE integration backend
description.zh: 通过语言服务器执行诊断、格式化、补全、符号查询和重命名。

description.en: The execution maze for DeepSeek Harness agents: see how the agent actually worked — main path, detours and backtracks on one timeline, with data tracks, deterministic analysis, and multi-session comparison
description.zh: 在时间线上查看任务路径、绕行与回退，并比较多个会话。

description.en: Manage MCP servers visually and discover or load tools on demand.
description.zh: 可视化管理 MCP 服务器，并按需检索和加载工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness MCP Connector: connect servers, search tools across active connections, and troubleshoot discovery. Includes a continuously updated catalog; supports OAuth 2.0 PKCE, API keys, Streamable HTTP/stdio, and mcpServers JSON import.
description.zh: 连接 MCP 服务器，检索活跃连接中的工具并诊断发现问题。

description.en: Manage MCP servers, inspect health and try tool pipelines from the interface or command.
description.zh: 通过界面或命令管理 MCP 服务器、检查状态并试运行工具管道。

description.en: Keep layered cross-session memories in local SQLite with retrieval, write approvals, and context injection.
description.zh: 以本地 SQLite 保存分层跨会话记忆，提供检索、写入审批和上下文注入。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: multi-channel retrieval and an evolving memory store.
description.zh: 通过多通道检索维护和召回长期记忆。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) local-first cross-session project memory: bounded cache-friendly Hot Memory, BM25 recall/cache, provenance, lifecycle and bilingual Web GUI; no embeddings, external service or bundled runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 用本地热记忆、BM25 检索与来源记录保存跨会话项目知识。

description.en: Composable memory with pluggable sources and strategies for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可组合记忆、可插拔来源与记忆策略。

description.en: One-click context window matching and selective bulk configuration for DeepSeek Harness models, with source references and manual management.
description.zh: 按参考来源匹配模型上下文窗口，并选择性批量配置。

description.en: Fusion for DeepSeek Harness: one model entry backed by a frontier Lead that reads, briefs and reviews, and a much cheaper Sidekick that writes the code.
description.zh: 让主模型负责阅读、简报与复核，由副模型承担代码编写。

description.en: Readable conversational UI, interactive HTML/SVG, editable motion and local MP4 production for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 提供可读会话界面、交互 HTML/SVG、动画编辑与本机视频制作。

description.en: Play music alongside coding conversations.
description.zh: 在编程会话中使用音乐播放功能。

description.en: Show desktop or webhook notifications for task completion, questions and approvals.
description.zh: 为任务完成、提问和审批发送桌面或 Webhook 通知。

description.en: Manage chapter drafting, setting constraints, repetition checks and whole-book reviews.
description.zh: 管理章节写作、设定约束、重复检查、批量起草与全书复核。

description.en: Manage chapter references, narrative continuity, revision checks and writing materials.
description.zh: 管理章节参考、叙事连贯性、改稿检查与创作素材。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness (dsh) to a local Obsidian vault: search, read, write, move, and trash notes.
description.zh: 搜索、读取、编辑、移动和删除本机 Obsidian 笔记。

description.en: Create and read documents, spreadsheets, and presentations in the session workspace, and update documents and spreadsheets.
description.zh: 在会话工作区中创建和读取文档、表格与演示文稿，并更新文档和表格。

description.en: A typed, inference-capable ontology (TBox + ABox) plugin for DeepSeek Harness — durable domain knowledge the agent can define, assert against, and query under schema constraints.
description.zh: 定义带类型与约束的领域知识，并进行断言、查询和推理。

description.en: Manage OpenCode Go models and multiple accounts with subscription quota displays in DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理 OpenCode Go 模型与多个账号，并显示订阅额度。

description.en: Apply a collection of persistent color themes to the web interface.
description.zh: 为网页界面应用多套可持久保存的主题配色。

description.en: Control OriginLab data import, scientific plot templates and figure edits through MCP tools.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 工具操作 OriginLab 数据导入、科研图模板与图表编辑。

description.en: dsh-passwords: a server-grade gateway that turns DeepSeek Harness into a multi-tenant platform — remote access + automatic HTTPS, per-subuser permissions & quotas, sandbox enforcement, first-run setup, SQLite auth with at-rest encryption, rate-limit and audit log (bilingual zh/en UI)
description.zh: 为远程访问配置登录、用户权限、配额、HTTPS 与审计日志。

description.en: Pause before the next model request so the user can add instructions and continue manually.
description.zh: 在下一次模型请求前暂停，允许用户补充文字并手动继续。

description.en: Minimal Root-Orchestrator PTES pentesting plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供按 PTES 流程组织的测试编排预设。

description.en: Define allow, deny and ask rules for tools, arguments, workspace paths and network targets.
description.zh: 按工具、参数、工作区路径与网络目标配置允许、拒绝和询问规则。

description.en: Import, switch and manage bundled or custom conversation personas.
description.zh: 导入、切换和管理内置或自定义会话人设。

description.en: Inspect token usage, costs and session state, and configure personal preferences.
description.zh: 集中查看 Token 用量、费用、会话状态并调整个人偏好。

description.en: Show session events through a sticker companion, status bubbles and a desktop window.
description.zh: 用贴纸角色、状态气泡与桌面浮窗反映会话事件。

description.en: Browse, search and install community plugins inside DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中浏览、搜索并安装社区插件。

description.en: Previewable cross-preset session migration for DeepSeek Harness with bounded, fixed-schema handoffs
description.zh: 预览并生成结构化交接资料，在不同预设之间迁移会话。

description.en: A TypeScript-based Garmin Connect plugin and MCP server with secure browser-based MFA for DeepSeek Harness and other AI agents
description.zh: 通过插件与 MCP 服务连接 Garmin Connect 账户。

description.en: Turn any markdown, local folder, or GitHub learning repo into a guided course inside DeepSeek Harness: gated skill-tree progression, BKT mastery tracking, SM-2 spaced repetition.
description.zh: 将 Markdown、文件夹或学习仓库组织为带复习安排的课程。

description.en: ChatGPT-style message editing for DeepSeek Harness: edit a past prompt to rewind and branch the conversation, switch versions with a counter under the bubble, and browse branches in a tree.
description.zh: 编辑历史提示词以回退和分支会话，并在树中浏览版本。

description.en: Pair mobile devices and synchronize sessions and files over LAN or a Cloudflare tunnel.
description.zh: 配对移动设备，同步会话与文件，支持局域网和 Cloudflare 隧道。

description.en: Creative branching canvas plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在创意画布中分支和组织会话内容。

description.en: Subagent Director: choose an LLM provider/model for each subagent (call args > role binding > plugin default > inherit parent) and plan main-agent/subagent responsibilities with role templates, plus a settings UI.
description.zh: 按调用参数、角色与默认策略为子 Agent 选择模型。

description.en: Mobile client for the DeepSeek Harness — use the dsh on your dev machine from your Android or iOS phone, remotely across networks, peer-to-peer over iroh with no server to set up (falls back to a relay that only sees ciphertext)
description.zh: 通过点对点或中继连接，从 Android 与 iOS 访问电脑上的 DSH。

description.en: Use local Wallpaper Engine scenes, web wallpapers and videos behind the DSH interface.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面使用本机 Wallpaper Engine 场景、网页与视频壁纸。

description.en: Personal assistant plugin for deepseek-harness that organizes commitments from conversations, tracks plans across sessions, and delivers low-interruption reminders.
description.zh: 从会话整理承诺与计划，跨会话追踪并提供提醒。

description.en: Pair a phone with desktop DSH over LAN or a public connection to follow the same session.
description.zh: 通过局域网或公网将手机与电脑 DSH 配对，同步访问会话。

description.en: View artifacts in a sidebar or open the panel in a larger browser tab.
description.zh: 在侧栏查看产物，或将面板弹出为更大的浏览器标签页。

description.en: Manage preset and custom prompt templates and insert them into the composer.
description.zh: 管理预设和自定义模板，一键插入当前输入框。

description.en: dsh-qa QA Workbench: a local software testing workbench plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Project/iteration dual-mode, full-flow requirements / test cases / defects / milestones / reports, native QA preset, settings, release history, kanban and calendar.
description.zh: 管理需求、测试用例、缺陷、里程碑、报告与版本记录。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: 10 testing skills (requirement analysis, test strategy, case writing/review, E2E/API automation, exploratory, regression, bug analysis) + shared core knowledge base — a full QA pipeline as agent skills.
description.zh: 提供需求分析、测试策略、用例、自动化、探索与回归测试技能。

description.en: Connect domestic and international Qoder model services to DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 Qoder 国内与国际模型服务。

description.en: Turn conversation Markdown headings into a searchable outline with previews and navigation.
description.zh: 把会话中的 Markdown 标题整理为可搜索大纲，支持预览与跳转。

description.en: Read webpages and feeds with encoding detection, pagination and compact text output.
description.zh: 识别编码并读取网页与订阅源，处理分页，输出精简正文。

description.en: Restore the conversation and workspace before a sent message, then edit and resend it.
description.zh: 将会话和工作区恢复到消息发送前，再编辑并重发消息。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: recall sent-but-unread text messages before the model reads them.
description.zh: 在模型读取前撤回已发送但尚未处理的文字消息。

description.en: Search and recommend plugins using a public scoring model and a settings-page ranking.
description.zh: 按公开评分模型检索和推荐插件，并在设置页展示排行。

description.en: Connect remote SSH workspaces with file operations, mirror sync, deployment and port forwarding.
description.zh: 连接 SSH 远程工作区，使用文件操作、镜像同步、部署与端口转发。

description.en: Provide remote access, QR sign-in and connection management over LAN or Tailscale.
description.zh: 通过局域网或 Tailscale 提供远程访问、扫码登录与连接管理。

description.en: Bind research claims to snapshots and export versioned reports with verification records.
description.zh: 将研究结论绑定到快照，导出带核验记录的版本化报告。

description.en: Per-request tier routing on the Laya judge, plus an Auto tier chip in the composer
description.zh: 按请求判定模型档位，并在输入栏显示自动档位。

description.en: Inspect injection patterns, redaction rules and local configuration, and produce risk reports.
description.zh: 检查提示注入模式、脱敏规则与本机配置，并输出风险报告。

description.en: Move, archive and tag sessions in batches, and manage workspace visibility and preset migration.
description.zh: 批量移动、归档和标记会话，管理工作区显示与预设迁移。

description.en: Cross-device sync for DeepSeek Harness sessions: a dedicated git mirror of the session store, append-only three-way merge with keep-both + fork conflict resolution, /sync command, sync_pull/sync_push/sync_status tools, and configurable auto push/pull
description.zh: 通过独立 Git 镜像同步会话，并处理合并与分支冲突。

description.en: Search session history, recall cited content and organize conversation views.
description.zh: 全文检索历史会话、引用召回内容，并管理会话视图。

description.en: Archive, restore, delete or move sessions between workspaces from one panel.
description.zh: 在统一面板归档、恢复、删除或跨工作区移动会话。

description.en: Create images and videos through ComfyUI-backed tools and a conversation-linked canvas.
description.zh: 通过 ComfyUI 工具与关联会话的画布制作图片和视频。

description.en: DSH web plugin: select conversation text -> ask in a right-side panel -> a dedicated follow-up session (❓<topic>) in the same workspace, without interrupting the main conversation. Runs on DSH's own right sidebar, with no extra dependencies.
description.zh: 选择对话文字，在同一工作区的独立会话中继续追问。

description.en: Browse and toggle skills, diagnose metadata problems, and import or track updates from repositories.
description.zh: 在设置页浏览和开关技能，检查格式问题，并从仓库导入及跟踪更新。

description.en: dsh-skill-mcp-panel: manage skills and MCP servers from the DSH web sidebar plus the unified dsh-panel CLI.
description.zh: 通过网页侧栏与命令行统一管理技能和 MCP 服务器。

description.en: DSH Web GUI skill picker: a button beside the composer opens a searchable list of installed skills; picking one inserts the official `/skill-name` gesture into the input box, so the skill loads with your message (WorkBuddy-style skill invocation for DeepSeek Harness).
description.zh: 搜索已安装技能，并将官方技能调用指令插入输入框。

description.en: Discover skills from local directories and Git sources for on-demand loading through DSH or local MCP.
description.zh: 汇总本地与 Git 来源的技能，供 DSH 或本地 MCP 按需加载。

description.en: Native skin marketplace and lifecycle manager for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 浏览和管理 DSH 原生主题皮肤。

description.en: Add a smoothly moving comet cursor to the chat composer with configurable trails, colors, and thickness.
description.zh: 为聊天输入框添加平滑移动的彗星光标，可调整拖尾、颜色与粗细。

description.en: Fluid streaming rendering and silky scrolling for DeepSeek Harness replies, including Markdown, code blocks, tables, and tool results.
description.zh: 调整 Markdown、代码、表格与工具结果的流式渲染和滚动。

description.en: Turn the DSH Web status line into a 1317-phrase meme machine: phase-aware phrases, typewriter, rainbow gradient, danmaku and 14 theme packs, all editable from the settings page.
description.zh: 按运行阶段显示可编辑文案、主题与状态栏动画。

description.en: Keep current reasoning visible and fold older thinking and tool output into compact summaries.
description.zh: 展示当前思考，将较早的思考与工具输出折叠为简短摘要。

description.en: Register Superpowers development skills and session guidance with the DSH skills and prompt services.
description.zh: 接入 Superpowers 开发技能，并向会话提示词添加使用引导。

description.en: Tabbit Browser bundle for DeepSeek Harness: a code-first tabbit_browser tool, browser-backed web_fetch, @tab composer mentions, a dedicated page-access permission, an environment preflight with background installer download, and a daily plugin update check.
description.zh: 操作 Tabbit 标签页，抓取网页，并在输入框引用浏览器内容。

description.en: Track project tasks and run them in sessions with optional per-task Git worktrees.
description.zh: 跟踪项目任务并在会话中执行，可为任务配置独立 Git 工作树。

description.en: Manage character cards, worldbooks, presets, memory and plot options; some features require companion plugins.
description.zh: 管理角色卡、世界书、预设、记忆与剧情选项，部分功能需配套插件。

description.en: Apply a Firefly character theme with wallpaper, colors and an opening animation.
description.zh: 应用流萤角色壁纸、主题配色与开场动画。

description.en: Mineradio: a cinematic private-visual-radio glass theme for the Web surface — champagne glow, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, unified corners, and motion
description.zh: 为网页界面添加电台风格配色、玻璃表面、壁纸与动效。

description.en: Display-layer translation for the DSH web app: thinking chain, task cards, and optional answer text, in 8 target languages (local Ollama / any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic endpoint / Google / Bing, fail-open)
description.zh: 在显示层翻译思考、任务卡片及可选的回答文字。

description.en: Turn the current session into an editable thought graph on an infinite canvas.
description.zh: 将当前会话整理为无限画布上的可编辑思维图。

description.en: Connect native web search and fetch tools to TinyFish through direct or Monid access.
description.zh: 为网页搜索与抓取接入 TinyFish，支持直连或 Monid 通道。

description.en: A bilingual floating pet for DeepSeek Harness with runtime status, context and lifetime token usage, trends, and optional completion sounds.
description.zh: 用浮动角色展示运行状态、上下文与累计 Token 用量。

description.en: Responsive MCP management UI and skills manager for DeepSeek Harness Web — floating panel, JSON import, profile-backed Host Remote management, and a skill market with a hard license gate.
description.zh: 在浮动面板中管理 MCP、导入配置并浏览技能市场。

description.en: Appearance customization plugin for DeepSeek Harness WebUI: theme palette, background image, transparency and blur over the --dsw-* token system
description.zh: 调整主题配色、背景图片、透明度与模糊。

description.en: Adjust code typography, layout, branch indicators and conversation helpers from settings.
description.zh: 在设置面板调整代码字号、布局、分支显示与会话辅助功能。

description.en: DSH undo/rollback system: snapshot config files on change, undo/redo the last action from the WebUI or by chat, and roll back broken plugin trees without reinstalling. Works even when DSH fails to boot (offline CLI + GUI).
description.zh: 为配置变更保存快照，撤销操作并恢复损坏的插件配置。

description.en: Create, edit and review spreadsheets, documents and slides in DSH, with Office import and export.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内创建、编辑和审阅表格、文档与演示稿，支持 Office 导入导出。

description.en: Auto-check DeepSeek Harness updates for both dsh web and the Desktop app, check third-party plugin updates, notify in the GUI, one-click update with backup/rollback and restart watchdog.
description.zh: 检查 DSH 和第三方插件更新，提供备份、回滚与重启流程。

description.en: Display the current model provider’s balance, subscription quotas, and reset times above the composer.
description.zh: 在输入框上方显示当前模型供应商的账户余额、套餐额度及重置时间。

description.en: Use structured agent presets for mathematical exploration, solving and verification.
description.zh: 使用结构化 Agent 预设进行数学探索、求解与验证。

description.en: Route image questions to vision providers and expose OCR, grounding and pixel comparison tools.
description.zh: 将图片问题路由到视觉供应商，并提供 OCR、定位与像素比较工具。

description.en: Transcribe speech with local SenseVoice or optional services, with hotwords and text polishing.
description.zh: 使用本机 SenseVoice 或可选语音服务转录输入，支持热词与文字润色。

title.zh: 共享 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸

description.en: Sync active Wallpaper Engine wallpapers(image/video/scence/app)to DeepSeek Harness Web UI as a customizable dynamic background.
description.zh: 将当前 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸同步为可调整的网页背景。

description.en: Read-only DSH session insights and local model usage statistics
description.zh: 只读查看会话运行信息与本机模型用量统计。

description.en: Configurable User-Agent and non-public address allowlists for DeepSeek Harness web_fetch
description.zh: 配置网页抓取的 User-Agent 与非公网地址允许列表。

description.en: LAN / remote access support for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: self-contained 0.0.0.0 binding, remote Host settings, automatic /api trust-fence widening, and an insecure-origin randomUUID polyfill.
description.zh: 为网页界面配置局域网绑定和远程宿主访问。

description.en: Adapt the web interface for portrait screens and mobile devices.
description.zh: 为竖屏和移动设备调整网页界面布局。

description.en: Bridge WeChat (iLink bot) to DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 通过微信 iLink Bot 连接 DSH 会话。

description.en: A multi-character Galgame interface and optional desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 为网页会话添加多角色互动界面与可选桌面伴侣。

description.en: Show session progress, token usage and costs through a whale-girl companion and task bubbles.
description.zh: 用角色状态与任务气泡展示会话进度、Token 用量和费用。

description.en: Show account balance and per-turn usage in a customizable animated whale widget.
description.zh: 用可自定义的鲸鱼挂件显示账户余额与每轮用量。

description.en: Connect models available in the local WorkBuddy desktop application to DSH.
description.zh: 将本机 WorkBuddy 桌面应用中可用的模型接入 DSH。

description.en: Run a session's shell and file tools inside a selected WSL distribution.
description.zh: 在选定的 WSL 发行版中运行会话命令与文件工具。

description.en: Aggregate accounts and provider models, inspect usage, and configure routing and a local gateway.
description.zh: 聚合多个账户与供应商模型，查看用量并配置路由和本地网关。

description.en: Read replies with Xiaomi MiMo TTS or the browser's local speech engine.
description.zh: 使用 Xiaomi MiMo TTS 或浏览器本地语音朗读回复。

description.en: Search a local Zotero library, read notes and annotations, extract evidence, and generate citations.
description.zh: 检索本地 Zotero 文献库，读取笔记和标注，提取证据并生成引用。

description.en: Browse community plugins and manage installations from a visual market inside DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内浏览社区插件，并通过可视化市场管理安装。

description.en: Check and revise Chinese official documents with formatting rules and templates.
description.zh: 使用格式规则和模板检查、修订中文公文。

description.en: Agent toolkit that helps coding agents use Huawei Cloud Skills, KooCLI, APIs, SDKs, and future MCP capabilities safely and accurately.
description.zh: 在编程会话中使用华为云技能、KooCLI、API 与 SDK。

description.en: Store conversation knowledge cards in a local Markdown vault and recall them on demand.
description.zh: 将会话知识卡保存到本地 Markdown 库，并按需召回。

description.en: Inspect token costs, cache-hit breakdowns and cumulative spending curves.
description.zh: 查看 Token 费用、缓存命中明细与累计花费曲线。

description.en: Cross-session project memory for DeepSeek Harness: seven-layer SQLite memory, first-turn snapshot injection, per-message keyword hits, memory_remember/search/project tools, automatic reflection with reflection-fold UI, and idle-triggered dream consolidation (peak-hour suppressed).
description.zh: 通过 SQLite 分层记忆、检索工具与自动反思保存项目知识。

description.en: Collapse the idle composer and automatically close the sidebar on narrow screens.
description.zh: 收起闲置输入框，并在窄屏选中会话后自动关闭侧栏。

description.en: Develop Minecraft server plugins and mods with version-aware skills and a Gradle runner.
description.zh: 使用区分版本的技能与 Gradle 工具开发 Minecraft 插件和模组。

description.en: Search evidence-rated failure lessons through the public MisakaNet MCP service.
description.zh: 通过 MisakaNet 公共 MCP 服务检索带证据评级的失败经验。

description.en: Realtime WebGPU ocean skin for DeepSeek Harness on Chrome and Edge
description.zh: 在 Chrome 或 Edge 中为 DSH 网页渲染实时海洋背景。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle: optimize raw instructions into professional Role / Task / Context / Format prompts through the harness llm service
description.zh: 通过当前模型将原始指令整理为角色、任务、上下文与格式。

description.en: PRTS.chat corpus browser with local/cloud search, source reading and a Rhine Lab 3D workspace for deepseek-harness
description.zh: 检索和阅读 PRTS.chat 语料，并使用角色化三维资料工作区。

description.en: Keep cross-session memories in local Markdown files and retrieve relevant content for context injection.
description.zh: 将跨会话记忆保存为本地 Markdown 文件，按问题检索并注入相关内容。

description.en: Local image-code knowledge library with native macOS and local Web clients, plus MCP and Skill for Pi, DeepSeek Harness (dsh), Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Wisp.
description.zh: 在本机检索图片与代码知识库，通过客户端、MCP 或技能调用。

description.en: Multi-engine web search for coding agents — one SearchBoost core (fused search, fetch, X) with MCP (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build, Antigravity), pi extension, and DeepSeek Harness bundle adapters
description.zh: 融合多引擎搜索、网页抓取与 X 检索，并提供 DSH 适配器。

description.en: Superpowers for the DeepSeek Harness: TDD, debugging, planning, and collaboration skills adapted from obra/superpowers
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入测试驱动开发、调试、规划与协作技能。

description.en: Add an interactive companion character to the DSH web interface.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面添加可互动桌面角色。
